partners.mechanism_chain: SLC6A19 (HGNC:11125) —DISRUPTS→ neutral amino acid transport (GO:0015170); neutral amino acid transport (GO:0015170) —DECREASES→ Tryptophan (CHEBI:17601); Tryptophan (CHEBI:17601) —DECREASES→ Nicotinamide (NAD) (CHEBI:17487); Nicotinamide (NAD) (CHEBI:17487) —LEADS_TO→ Ataxia (HP:0001251); SLC32A1 (HGNC:11128) —DISRUPTS→ glutamate transport (GO:0015872); glutamate transport (GO:0015872) —DECREASES→ Glutamate (CHEBI:15496); Glutamate (CHEBI:15496) —LEADS_TO→ Seizure (HP:0001250).
